articles.title: GCCs emerge as top career choice for tech talent
articles.summary: Indian technology professionals are increasingly looking for employers that offer hands-on artificial intelligence (AI) experience and clearly defined career paths, while multinational global capability centres (GCCs) are emerging as the preferred next career move for many, according to a Talent500 survey. Talent500 is part of ANSR, which has set up more than 200 GCCs in India.

articles.title: The future of technology is expanding beyond big cities: Can enterprise AI emerge
articles.summary: Nellore, a city in Andhra Pradesh, is becoming a test case for that question. In November 2025, entrepreneur Renil Komitla launched Blazeup, an enterprise artificial intelligence platform, from his hometown rather than a traditional technology hub. The platform brings together functions such as human resources, finance, IT service management, project management and customer relationship management within a common system.

articles.title: Two global tech centres to come up in North Karnataka region
articles.summary: Recently, the state government, under the Local Economy Accelerator Programme (LEAP), approved the establishment of GTCs of 10,000 sqft each in Hubballi and Belagavi with the objective of expanding Karnataka’s technology growth beyond Bengaluru. IT Minister Priyank Kharge stated that the GTCs, with plug-and-play facilities, are aimed at providing technology talent, startups and entrepreneurship with the infrastructure and opportunities locally.

articles.summary_hinglish: hala hi men, rajya sarakara ne sthaniya arthavyavastha tvaraka karyakrama (elaeeepi) ke tahat, bengaluru se pare karnataka ki praudyogiki vriddhi ka vistara karane ke uddeshya se hubali aura belagavi men pratyeka men 10,000 varga phuta ke jitisi ki sthapana ko manjuri di। aaeeti mantri priyanka khadage ne kaha ki plaga-enda-ple suvidhaon ke satha jitisi ka uddeshya sthaniya stara para buniyadi dhanche aura avasaron ke satha praudyogiki pratibh, startaapa aura udyamita pradana karana hai।

articles.summary: The prime suspect and alleged mastermind behind the operation, Jayanta Maiti, alongside his son, remains at large. While interrogations were conducted with employees at Maiti’s hotel and his family members, investigators failed to gather actionable leads.

articles.title: 'No satisfaction unless I play for India': Gurjapneet Singh after four-wicket haul against
articles.summary: For Gurjapneet Singh, a strong performance in domestic cricket is only another step towards a bigger goal. The Tamil Nadu left-arm pacer made an immediate impact against Uttarakhand in the Ranji Trophy, claiming four wickets on the opening day, but insisted that his job would remain unfinished until he earns a chance to represent India.

articles.title: Akshay Kumar meets Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami, discusses state’s film policy
articles.summary: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar met Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami at his official residence, where the two discussed the state’s film policy and its potential to attract more film productions. During the meeting, Dhami spoke about Uttarakhand’s efforts to establish itself as a preferred destination for filmmakers, citing its natural beauty, cultural heritage and investor-friendly policies.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff Unhurt After Firing In Mumbai, Driver Injured
articles.summary: Mumbai, Oct. 18: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff escaped unhurt after unidentified persons allegedly opened fire at a car carrying him in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday evening, police said. Two people, including the actor’s driver, were reportedly injured. The incident occurred near Pushpa Park within the jurisdiction of Juhu police station.

articles.title: ₹3,000 pension won't block parents' medical reimbursement for Haryana govt employees, High
articles.summary: The ruling is significant for government employees whose parents require hospitalisation or treatment but have modest pension income. It reinforces the principle that the receipt of a small social-security benefit does not automatically establish that an elderly parent can independently meet medical expenses. The court held that administrative instructions cannot override the statutory rules governing medical reimbursement.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh to Represent India at SCO Meeting in Tajikistan on October 19–20
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will represent India at the twenty-fifth meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Council of Heads of Government in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, on October nineteen to twenty, 2026. According to the Ministry of Defence, discussions will focus on trade, investment, connectivity, innovation, and cultural exchanges to advance regional economic engagement among member states.
articles.title_hi: राजनाथ सिंह 19-20 अक्टूबर को ताजिकिस्तान में एससीओ बैठक में भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व करेंगे

articles.title: Eugenio Chacarra Wins In India, Takes Race To Dubai Lead
articles.summary: The 26-year-old Spaniard captured the DP World India Championship on Sunday, October 18, finishing at 21-under 267 to claim a two-stroke victory over New Zealand's Daniel Hillier. articles.title: India to cut prices of 137 cancer drugs by up to 70% from November

articles.title: Beyond the exit poll: Can SCORE restore faith in India's election surveys
articles.summary: What it increasingly lacks is confidence in those making them. The broad problem is that election surveys have increasingly become television events rather than exercises in understanding society. Credible institutions and serious researchers must compete for attention with lesser-known operators offering extravagant forecasts, often without adequate public disclosure of their methods.

articles.summary_hi: एक पेंशन जो अब सहज महसूस होती है, कीमतें बढ़ने के साथ धीरे-धीरे कम हो सकती है, और सेवानिवृत्त लोगों को अपने मासिक बजट में अंतर दिखाई देने से पहले एक योजना की आवश्यकता होती है। यदि आज आपकी 40,000 रुपये मासिक पेंशन आराम से किराने का सामान, बिजली, नौकरानी और दवाओं को कवर करती है, तो यह लंबे समय तक ऐसा नहीं कर सकती है। कीमतें रिटायर नहीं होतीं.
articles.title_hinglish: kya penshana aaja aapake bilon ko kavara karati hai? ise lanbe samaya taka kayama rakhane ke 6 tarike
articles.summary_hinglish: eka penshana jo aba sahaja mahasusa hoti hai, kimaten badhane ke satha dhire-dhire kama ho sakati hai, aura sevanivritta logon ko apane masika bajata men antara dikhaee dene se pahale eka yojana ki aavashyakata hoti hai। yadi aaja aapaki 40,000 rupaye masika penshana aarama se kirane ka saman, bijali, naukarani aura davaon ko kavara karati hai, to yaha lanbe samaya taka aisa nahin kara sakati hai। kimaten ritayara nahin hotin.
